Without one, the phone itself can\'t protect Rún\'s keys — so Rún needs its strongest protection here. Two ways forward:
A PIN, pattern, password, or fingerprint all count. Any protection level is available once your phone has one.
Or create a passphrase now below — Maximum locks Rún itself, no screen lock needed. Four or five random words make a strong one.
Open Settings → Face ID & Passcode → Turn Passcode On, then come back to Rún. Any protection level is available once your phone has one.
Or create a passphrase now below — Maximum locks Rún itself, no device passcode needed. Four or five random words make a strong one.
